profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at ShootProof
profile.summary: I love making things with code, especially things people can directly interact with. I've been in the industry for a little over 12 years and have really made a home in frontend development. I've also dabbled in game jams and have had a lot of fun with that.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Foreground)
positions.description:
- Coordinated team as Scrum master for greenfield project, steadily improving the handoff to developers each sprint
- Implemented several resources in AWS via Terraform to create staging environments for a Node application, including an ECS Task, a Lambda function, and the VPC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Collage.com)
positions.description:
- Developed 3D editing feature for custom photo mugs (React, Three.js Raycaster), led to 10% reduction rate in user having to back to make changes after entering the Review step
- Facilitated product, UX, and myself in the design and implementation of a Google Photos integration in React

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Utilized AG Grid (which supported column virtualization) to greatly improve the performance of our main data grid
- Initiated the adoption of React Testing Library
- Co-managed UI component library
- Upgraded codebase from class-based components with Redux to functional components and Hooks
- Mentored junior developers and interns and led them in migrating a legacy feature to React

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Led React adoption and modern web development practices for greenfield project
- Engineered the React and Redux foundation for the greenfield project
- Designed high-fidelity UI mockups in UXPin
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · C# · TypeScript · Microsoft SQL Server · React.js
